identity.title: Differences in the Gas and Dust Distribution in the Transitional Disk of a Sun-like Young Star, PDS 70

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present ALMA 0.87 mm continuum, HCO^+^ J=4–3 emission line, and CO J=3–2 emission line data of the disk of material around the young, Sun-like star PDS 70.

evidence.quote: PDS 70 is a pre-main-sequence star with spectral type K5 and assumed to be part of the Centaurus association, estimated to be at a distance of 140 pc (cite: riaud06).
PDS 70 is a pre-main-sequence star with spectral type K5 and assumed to be part of the Centaurus association, estimated to be at a distance of 140 pc (cite: riaud06).

question.value: What are the structures of the gas and dust in the PDS 70 transitional disk, and do the gas features have dust counterparts?

evidence.quote: This is of particular interest to our study due to the existence of features which appear in the gas disk but are not present in the dust disk.
Observations were conducted on August 14 and 18, 2016 in the ALMA cycle 3 program (No. 2015.1.000888.S).

frequencies_and_spectral_setup.value: CO 3-2 at 345.761 GHz, HCO+ 4-3 at 356.698 GHz, continuum at 343.955 and 355.497 GHz; line bandwidth 468.75 MHz, 244.141 kHz resolution (~0.21 km/s)

evidence.quote: The correlator was tuned at the center frequency of 345.761 GHz for CO J=3–-2, 356.698 GHz for HCO^+^ J=4–-3, and 343.955 GHz and 355.497 GHz for continuum observations
center frequency of 345.761 GHz for CO J=3–-2
356.698 GHz for HCO^+^ J=4–-3
The array configuration provides a maximum and minimum baseline length of 1.5 km and 15.1 m, respectively.
the final synthesized beam of approximately $0.19\ensuremath{''}\times0.15\ensuremath{''}$ for the continuum image and CO J=3–2 map

findings_qualitative.value: HCO+ shows an azimuthal gap and a bridge with no dust counterpart; inner disk is gas-poor.

evidence.quote: The sub-au region of the disk is gas poor despite evidence for a dusty inner disk component.

claims.hypothesis: Do small and large grains have different gap radii in PDS 70?
claims.experiment: Compared ALMA 0.87 mm continuum with H-band imagery and MCRT model
claims.result: Similar radial extent, gap to ~60 au
claims.finding: No grain-size segregation in the outer disk; earlier difference due to SMA resolution

evidence.quote: We do not observe a difference between the small and large dust grain locations in the outer disk as proposed in previous work.

claims.hypothesis: Are there gas structures without dust analogues?
claims.experiment: HCO+ and CO moment maps compared to continuum
claims.result: Azimuthal gap and bridge in gas only

evidence.quote: Further study is needed however to determine the most likely candidate.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Mass transfer and polar outflow rejected for the bridge since no velocity change is seen

evidence.quote: there appears to be no significant change in velocity in the region of the bridge
